We need to count carbonyl groups (C=O) in the molecule. But we have no SMILES or structure given. The prompt says "Available input data:" but none shown. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve something? Maybe we need to request IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? But we need number of C=O groups. Could also retrieve carbon NMR shifts for carbonyl carbons. But we need the molecule. No SMILES provided. Maybe the environment has a sample "at hand". The tools like carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, etc. likely operate on the current sample. So we can get IR spectrum and look for carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1. But counting groups from IR is ambiguous. Better to get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon signals (~190-220 ppm). Could count them.

We can call carbon_nmr_spectra.
